attacks.name: Stab
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.

|!wild| |!wild| |*Stab, Stab|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make another |*Stab| attack. The additional attack must target the original defender. The additional attack does not have the |*Stab, Stab| special rule.

attacks.name: Bang
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.

attacks.name: Duodenum Poke
steps: After this attack is resolved, if it dealt |!damage|, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| and |§slow§Slow| special conditions.

superPowers.name: Merc with a Mouth

superPowers.name: You Can‘t Spell Legendary Without Leg Day
superPowers.body: Place this character within |!range| 2 of its current position. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: I Know Karate
superPowers.body: This character may reroll 1 die in its attack and defense rolls.

superPowers.name: Unicorns, Rainbows, and Sugar Plums Dancing Through My Head

erratas.body: Stamina increased from 4 to 5 on Healthy side.
"Stab" was added a new "Stab, Stab" special rule that can trigger an additional attack.
"Bang" was removed the new "Bang, Bang, Bang" special rule. Deadpool now gains 1 |!power| when using this attack.
"You Can‘t Spell Legendary Without Leg Day" superpower was added, it allows for a Place within |!range| 2.
"All Right, Now it‘s Serious..." on the Injured side now integrates the reroll that "I Know Karate" gives on the Healthy side.
